notes: rounds/tester.py record_result runs state_refusal (Closed round, superseded build) and the submitted check before the form and again under the round lock, reading the result through own_result (filtered by tester); results.record also fetches the row by tester before writing, and result_page's 'submitted' flag makes tester_result.html show a submitted result without a form. M1 drops the tester filter in own_result and results.record; M4 removes both submitted checks and sets 'submitted' to False, so the form is shown (the status line still reads Submitted) and a save turns it back into a draft. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation (no database constraint); OBSERVATION_LIMIT sets the length and its message. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005_results to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
